name: neozip-mcp

tools.name: compress
tools.description: Create a ZIP archive from files or directories. Defaults to Zstandard compression. Blockchain options require neozip-connect: options.timestamp (verified email), options.tokenize (wallet; supersedes timestamp), options.recipientEmails (full profile). timestamp and tokenize are mutually exclusive. Call connect_status before compress to see readiness and the next neozip-connect command. Set options.password for password ZIPs. recipientEmails is not combinable with timestamp or tokenize.

tools.name: extract
tools.description: Extract a ZIP archive to a directory. Pass options.password for ZipCrypto, WinZip AES-256, or NeoZip AES-256 encrypted entries. Supports overwrite control and timestamp preservation.

tools.name: list
tools.description: List the contents of a ZIP archive. Pass options.password for encrypted archives. JSON format includes per-entry encryptionScheme, archiveKind, and blockchain verification for timestamped/tokenized archives.

tools.name: info
tools.description: Get detailed metadata about a ZIP archive including file count, sizes, compression ratio, methods, encryption status, comment, merkle root, and blockchain timestamp/token verification when metadata is present. Use options.format=json for AI-friendly structured output.

tools.name: test
tools.description: Test ZIP integrity (per-entry checksums). Pass options.password for encrypted archives; set options.verifyPassword true to decrypt and verify the password. For timestamped or tokenized archives, also verifies blockchain status via Token Service / on-chain checks.

tools.name: read_entry
tools.description: Read the text contents of a specific file inside a ZIP archive without extracting the entire package. Pass options.password for encrypted entries. Supports chunking to fit LLM context limits.

tools.name: search_entries
tools.description: Perform a keyword or regex search across file names inside a ZIP archive. Pass options.password when the archive is encrypted.

tools.name: grep_entries
tools.description: Search for text strings or regex matches inside file bodies within a ZIP archive without extracting them. Pass options.password for encrypted archives.

tools.name: wiki_open
tools.description: Open a ZipWiki (.zipwiki) knowledge package: catalog of OKF concept cards, parsed documents, and origins, plus the recommended read sequence. Start here, then wiki_search / wiki_query. Defaults to wiki.zipwiki in a sandbox root.

tools.name: wiki_search
tools.description: Ranked search in a .zipwiki package: OKF concept cards first, parsed markdown as evidence fallback. Returns snippets and readHints for wiki_read.

tools.name: wiki_query
tools.description: Search a .zipwiki package and return cited passages from the top hits (and gaps where no text extract was stored). Use to answer questions with evidence.

tools.name: wiki_read
tools.description: Stream-read one item from a .zipwiki package without extracting: manifest, an OKF card (okf stem), a parsed document (parsed name), or any entry (path). Integrity-checked (CRC-32, SHA-256 when present). Supports offset/maxBytes paging.

tools.name: wiki_extract
tools.description: Extract entries from a .zipwiki package to a sandboxed directory with integrity checks. Prefer wiki_read unless a filesystem path is required.

tools.name: wiki_origin
tools.description: Resolve the original document for a parsed entry (Extra Field 0x014F origin). With fetch: true, download and verify CRC-32 (requires NEOZIP_MCP_WIKI_ALLOW_ORIGIN_FETCH=true); optional dest writes the verified file inside the sandbox.

tools.name: wiki_verify
tools.description: Verify every entry of a .zipwiki package (CRC-32, SHA-256 when present) and flag paths that do not belong in a ZipWiki package.

tools.name: prune_analyze
tools.description: Beta. Dry run of neozip-prune: list the parts of Office documents (.docx/.xlsx/.pptx, other ZIP containers) and PDFs, and report the shared parts (fonts, styles, themes, images) and bytes a pruned archive would save. Read-only.

tools.name: prune_create
tools.description: Beta. Create a pruned .nzip from files/directories: parts shared across documents are stored once under META-INF/PRUNE/ITEMS/ and each document is rebuilt byte-for-byte on extract (verified by default). Best for collections of Office documents/PDFs from one source. Method 208 entries need neozip tools to extract. options.dryRun analyzes only.

tools.name: prune_info
tools.description: Beta. Describe a pruned archive (META-INF/PRUNE.NZIP): format version, shared parts, and per-entry mode/sizes. Returns pruned: false for regular archives. extract/test/read_entry/grep_entries/info/list already handle pruned archives.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Verify a tokenized ZIP file's authenticity by checking its TOKEN.NZIP metadata against the blockchain. Pass options.password if payload entries are encrypted.

tools.name: upgrade_timestamped
tools.description: Upgrade Timestamped archive: replace META-INF/TS-SUBMIT.NZIP with META-INF/TIMESTAMP.NZIP once the Token Service batch is confirmed on-chain. Enables independent blockchain verification without live Token Service calls.

tools.name: token_service_status
tools.description: Check NeoZip Token Service email verification status for timestamping. Reports connect profile email and Token Service URL when configured.

tools.name: lookup_recipient
tools.description: Look up a recipient's Token Service X25519 public key by verified email (GET /crypto/public). Use before compress with options.recipientEmails. Does not return private keys.

tools.name: wallet_info
tools.description: Display wallet and network status including masked key, address, balance, and supported networks.

tools.name: wallet_config_status
tools.description: Report how wallet, Token Service, and identity credentials are configured (sources and readiness flags; no secret values).

tools.name: connect_status
tools.description: Fast neozip-connect readiness check: phase, store health, compress/blockchain tool readiness, interactive and scriptable next commands. Call before compress with timestamp/tokenize/recipientEmails. No network calls.

tools.name: identity_status
tools.description: Query Token Service GET /crypto/self for provisioned X25519 identity (requires NEOZIP_TOKEN_SERVICE_ACCESS_TOKEN in MCP env).
